fields.summary_ko.0: Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) stock price rose 6.4% on favorable earnings announcement by competitor SK Hynix, with stock surge exceeding 650% over the past year
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix noted that 'AI memory chip demand will exceed supply through 2030,' suggesting intensifying memory chip supply shortage
fields.summary_ko.2: Sandisk currently valued at 19x P/E, and as one of three major memory manufacturers is expected to benefit from AI-related supply-demand imbalance
